info.title: Runkite Admin API
info.description: Cross-tenant administrative API for the Runkite control plane. Requires admin permission.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Administrative endpoints for managing the Runkite deployment.

BearerAuth.description: Admin key (auth.admin_keys) or primary auth credential with admin permission.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Admin API key via X-API-Key (alternative to Bearer).

pause_only.description: true = refuse creates only; false = also cancel non-terminal runs

tools.description: Empty = all tools on the connector

post.description: Exchange an API key/JWT for an httpOnly session cookie + CSRF token. The credential is not retained by the browser afterward.

get.description: Bootstrap probe: returns whether a session cookie is active (and its CSRF token), or whether auth is required at all.

delete.description: Logout. Requires the session cookie and X-CSRF-Token (unlike Bearer machine clients).
